stops.note: 'pole, rafter', also 'antler': Caber Féidh, 'deer's antler', is the badge and pipe tune of Clan Mackenzie
tossing the caber is the centrepiece of Highland games; Queen Victoria first attended the Braemar Gathering in 1848, starting its royal patronage
stops.meaning: tree trunk tossed in Highland games

current_meaning: a long heavy wooden pole tossed end over end in Scottish Highland games
